levels.surface: خالد بن الحارث الهجيمي أبو عثمان

notes: «قال دخلنا على فاطمة بنت قيس» places the Shu'bi's entry to her place; she then answers and speaks, so she is the last link (rule 6)
The Prophet's speech she heard is the saying; he is not a link
«وساق الحديث وزاد فيه» continues the same report: one group
